handoffs.rationale: TENT-731 meets all user requirements: price $69 (under $100 limit), independent durability certificate CERT-7318 with quality score 4.8 (exceeds 4.0 minimum), and comprehensive lab testing (72-hour 45mph wind, 3000mm hydrostatic head, 200-cycle pole fatigue, 150D floor abrasion). TENT-284 is unsuitable because its certificate CERT-4107 explicitly covers only the 2P variant, not the 4P configuration being sold, and evidence shows pole hub failures and seam leaks in the 4P model. TENT-731 is supported by independent laboratory evidence meeting the required-evidence mandate.
